findings.issue: Empty string bypass in authorization gates
findings.description: The can_transition_to_implementing() function validates required parameters with 'if not requester_id' guards, but empty strings pass Python's truthiness check. Callers could bypass early validation by passing empty strings.
findings.action: Change parameter validation to 'if not requester_id or requester_id.strip() == ""' for requester_id, candidate_sha256, manifest_id, and manifest_sha256.

findings.issue: Agent coordinator does not call governance service
findings.description: The design requires AgentCoordinator and WorkflowEngine to call governance_service.transition_state() after agent completion. The coordinator file was not modified in this diff. Agents can execute but workflow state never advances.
findings.action: Wire agent completion to state transitions.

findings.description: The design specifies removing frontend localStorage state tracking and consuming backend canonical states via /workflows/{id}. No frontend changes were made. The frontend still maintains independent state.
The design requires adding deprecation warnings to /tasks endpoints and documenting migration path. The task routes file was not modified. Existing callers still hit old endpoints.
findings.action: Add deprecation notices and interim forwarding.

findings.issue: Evidence attachment not wired to agent execution
findings.description: The governance service accepts evidence_id in transition_state() but agents don't call this API. Evidence accumulation is central to the certification model.
findings.action: Wire agent results to evidence binding.

findings.issue: Approval routes do not call governance service
findings.description: The governance routes (approve_manifest) still use in-memory _approvals dict instead of calling governance_service.register_approval(). Approvals are isolated from workflows.
findings.action: Integrate approval flow with governance service.
